title: hearthmap readings fixture
description: A snapshot of Home Assistant sensor states at one moment, for the host renderer and tests. Not used on the device. Format: examples/README.md, 'Readings fixtures'.

description.description: What this fixture is for and what it should show. Free text.

now.description: The moment the snapshot represents; passed to core as 'now'.

readings.description: Entity id -> reading. An entity absent here is 'missing' (never received).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset, e.g. 2026-01-15T09:00:00Z.

value.description: The numeric state, or the literal HA states 'unavailable' / 'unknown'.

unit.description: unit_of_measurement as HA reports it. Informational; core does not convert.
